key_insight: Instead of only making a language model compute longer or go deeper, Latent Lattice Language Models increase how many computational states it maintains. A lattice of latent streams carries information through time alongside the usual flow through network depth.
problem_solved: How can language models expand their computational capacity beyond deeper layers, repeated computation, or additional latent reasoning steps?
method: Introduce a 'Lattice of Latents': horizontal latent streams associated with individual layers.
Run these streams recurrently across time, alongside the vertical residual stream that passes through model depth.
Organize computation across both time and depth, expanding the set of active states the model maintains.
impact: This offers practitioners a different architectural direction for expanding language-model capacity: maintain more states rather than only adding computation steps. The provided abstract is incomplete, so performance gains and efficiency trade-offs cannot be assessed.
